response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_rel_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END), 0) AS area_vol_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(area_vol_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.fundflux, g.avg_rel_diff, g.area_vol_ratio, g.area_vol_ratio - a.avg_ratio AS ratio_above_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.area_vol_ratio > a.avg_ratio
